project.title: Projects
project.alreadyProject: This folder already has a project; open it instead
project.notOnline: That agent's terminal is not open
project.agentBlocked: The agent is waiting for an answer; handle it in its terminal first
project.agentBusy: The agent is busy; try again when it is idle
project.agentNotReady: The agent did not become ready in time
project.needsApproval: This agent says running highostty ctl needs your approval. Allow it in that agent yourself; the project will not do it for you.
project.modelPlaceholder: Default model, e.g. sonnet (optional; the coordinator may pick another per task)
project.pickHint: Pick the terminal this member runs in:
project.pickNone: No such tab is open. Start claude, codex, copilot or gemini from a favorite or command with tmux turned on.
project.noMessages: No messages yet. Talk to the coordinator here.
project.name: Project name
project.needFolder: Choose a folder and enter a name
project.needFull: Agents can only read this project until agent control is set to Full; they cannot introduce themselves or reply.
project.needFullOff: Agent control is off, so agents cannot reach this project at all.
project.pickRule: Only tabs started with Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI or Gemini CLI (command claude, codex, copilot or gemini) and run in tmux can be members, so they stay linked after a restart.
project.lockedHelp: This terminal is a member of project “{project}”. Its agent can only be chosen from the list and it always runs in tmux, so it stays linked after a restart. Remove it from the project to change this.
project.coordinatorTmux: Runs in tmux so it keeps running and stays linked after a restart
project.plan.title: Plan
project.plan.none: No plan yet. Ask the coordinator to draft one in the discussion.
project.plan.blockHello: The coordinator has not introduced itself yet.
project.task.wait.dependency: Waiting for an earlier step to be accepted.
project.task.wait.busy: This member is still on another task.
project.task.wait.offline: The member's terminal is not open here.
project.task.cancelRequested: Cancel requested; it takes effect when the member confirms. Interrupt it in its terminal yourself if it does not.
project.task.inProgress: In progress. Nothing is judged from the terminal being idle; wait for its report.
project.task.question: Question: {text}
project.task.uncertain: The prompt may or may not have reached the agent. Check its terminal, then choose what happened.
project.task.reworkPlaceholder: What to change (required to send back)
project.task.resultBeforeCancel: A result arrived before the cancel took effect.
project.task.noPrompt: Could not build the task prompt
project.task.staleReports: {n} late report(s) kept but not applied
project.attention.title: Needs you
project.attention.blocked: “{name}”'s terminal is waiting for an answer (a permission or a menu). The task cannot move on; handle it in the terminal — the project never presses keys for you.
project.attention.stalled: “{name}” has not reported for over {minutes} minutes on “{task}”. Silence does not mean it failed.
project.run.auto: Hand over automatically when the agent is ready
project.run.autoHelp: With this on, each task is typed into its agent as soon as every check passes (control mode Full, agent idle, you are not at its terminal). Off: you press Hand over yourself.
project.attention.held: You are using “{name}”'s terminal, so {n} task(s) are paused.
project.task.observed: The coordinator wrote this down from the screen (not a report from the member): {summary}
project.task.wait.control-mode: Agent control is not set to Full, so automatic hand-over is off.
project.task.wait.other-project: This agent is working for another project.
project.task.wait.held: You are using this terminal; hand-over is paused.
project.task.wait.agent-blocked: The agent is waiting for an answer in its terminal.
project.task.wait.agent-unknown: No agent was found in that terminal.
project.drop.kind.question: Question
project.drop.uncertain: Not sure whether “{title}” reached {name}. Check its terminal, then say what happened.
project.work.label: Run each task in its own session
project.work.help: Starts a fresh agent for every task with this member's settings, so your own conversation with it is never typed into. Needs its terminal open to copy the settings.
project.work.on: New session per task, in {cwd}. Your own terminal is left alone.
project.work.dropped: Left out of the new sessions (they point at your own conversation): {flags}
project.work.fail.offline: Open this member's terminal first so its start command can be read.
project.work.fail.not-agent: This terminal was not started as a supported agent.
project.work.fail.env-prefix: The start command begins with VAR=value settings, which a new session would lose. Start the agent without them.
project.work.fail.wrapper: The start command is an alias or wrapper, so its real arguments are unknown. Start the agent by its own name.
project.work.fail.unparseable: The start command uses shell syntax that cannot be copied safely.
project.drop.planChanged: The plan changed after this card was drawn. Look at the new one before starting.
project.banner.question: {project} · {name} has a question for you
